{{Quote|Moons of Baroli, what's going on?|[[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]]|<ref name="Reversal of Fortune">''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref>}}
'''Baroli''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] inhabited by blue-haired [[Human/Legends|Humans]], and known for its many interesting [[Moon/Legends|moons]].

The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] slicer [[Zakarisz Ghent]] hailed from Baroli,<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> as did [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]].
